variables.name: SAMSUNG_TAIL_SIGNATURE
variables.comment:
* Hex representation of `SEFT` (in ASCII). * *

This is the last 4 bytes of a file that has Samsung Extension Format (SEF) data.

variables.name: TAIL_HEADER_LENGTH
variables.comment: Start signature (4 bytes), SEF version (4 bytes), SDR count (4 bytes).

variables.name: TAIL_FOOTER_LENGTH
variables.comment: Tail offset (4 bytes), tail signature (4 bytes).
